<translated_code>
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {

    static class Aresta {
        int from, to, rev, flow, cap;

        public Aresta(int from, int to, int rev, int flow, int cap) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
        }

        int residuo() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int size;
        ArrayList<Aresta>[] grafo;
        Aresta[] prev;
        boolean[] vis;

        public EdmondsKarp(int tam) {
            size = tam;
            grafo = new ArrayList[size];
            prev = new Aresta[size];
            vis = new boolean[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                grafo[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void limpa() {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (Aresta a : grafo[i]) {
                    grafo[i].remove(a);
                }
            }
        }

        void destroy() {
            limpa();
            Arrays.fill(prev, null);
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        }

        void add(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, 0);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        void undirectedAdd(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, cap);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(prev, null);
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Queue<Integer> fila = new ArrayDeque<>();
            fila.add(source);
            vis[source] = true;

            while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
                int atual = fila.poll();

                if (atual == sink) return true;

                for (Aresta a : grafo[atual]) {
                    if (!vis[a.to] && a.residuo() > 0) {
                        prev[a.to] = a;
                        vis[a.to] = true;
                        fila.add(a.to);
                    }
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        int dfs(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = sink;
            while (v != source) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, prev[v].residuo());
                v = prev[v].from;
            }

            v = sink;
            Aresta a;
            while (v != source) {
                a = prev[v];
                a.flow += flow;
                grafo[a.to].get(a.rev).flow -= flow;
                v = a.from;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long long int flow(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(source, sink)) {
                flow += dfs(source, sink);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static class coord {
        int x, y, qtd;

        public coord(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a;
            y = b;
            qtd = c;
        }

        boolean is_valid(int N) {
            return (x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && station[x][y] == ROOM);
        }
    }

    static int station[][] = new int[300][300];
    static int checkpoint[][] = new int[300][300];
    static int veneno[][][] = new int[61][300][300];
    static ArrayList<coord> pessoas = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<coord> capsulas = new ArrayList<>();
    static int moveX[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};  //^<v>
    static int moveY[] = {0, -1, 0, 1};  //^<v>

    static int trad(char ch) {
        switch (ch) {
            case '0':
            case '1':
            case '2':
            case '3':
            case '4':
            case '5':
            case '6':
            case '7':
            case '8':
            case '9':
                return ROOM;
            case 'Y':
                return REAC;
            case 'Z':
                return BAD_REAC;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static int how_much(char ch) {
        return ch - '0';
    }

    static int bfs(coord from, coord to, int N) {
        boolean[][] vis = new boolean[300][300];
        Queue<pair<Integer, coord>> fila = new ArrayDeque<>();
        fila.add(new pair<>(0, from));
        vis[from.x][from.y] = true;

        while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
            int tempo = fila.peek().first;
            coord atual = fila.peek().second;
            fila.poll();

            if (atual == to) return tempo;

            if (veneno[tempo][atual.x][atual.y]) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                coord next = new coord(atual.x + moveX[i], atual.y + moveY[i], 0);
                if (next.is_valid(N) && !vis[next.x][next.y]) {
                    if (!veneno[tempo][next.x][next.y]) {
                        fila.add(new pair<>(tempo + 1, next));
                        vis[next.x][next.y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return 999;
    }

    static void espalha_veneno(int x, int y, int T, int N) {
        veneno[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= T; i++) {
            for (int lin = 0; lin < N; lin++) {
                for (int col = 0; col < N; col++) {
                    if (veneno[i - 1][lin][col]) {
                        veneno[i][lin][col] = 1;
                        for (int move = 0; move < 4; move++) {
                            if (is_valid(lin + moveX[move], col + moveY[move], N)) {
                                veneno[i][lin + moveX[move]][col + moveY[move]] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int N, T;
        pw.print("Enter the number of rows and columns: ");
        pw.flush();
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);

        char ch;
        coord bad = new coord(0, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                pw.print("Enter the character at position (" + i + "," + j + "): ");
                pw.flush();
                ch = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                station[i][j] = trad(ch);
                if (station[i][j] == BAD_REAC) {
                    bad = new coord(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                pw.print("Enter the character at position (" + i + "," + j + "): ");
                pw.flush();
                ch = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                if (trad(ch) == CAPS && how_much(ch) > 0) {
                    capsulas.add(new coord(i, j, how_much(ch)));
                    checkpoint[i][j] = how_much(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        EdmondsKarp din = new EdmondsKarp(N);
        int sink = N - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < pessoas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(0, i * 2 + 1, pessoas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < capsulas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(i * 2 + 2, sink, capsulas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        espalha_veneno(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < pessoas.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capsulas.size(); j++) {
                int tempo = bfs(pessoas.get(i), capsulas.get(j), N);
                if (tempo <= T) {
                    din.add(i * 2 + 1, j * 2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        pw.println(din.flow(0, sink));
        pw.close();
    }
}
